title: Always, sometimes, never
subtitle: A class survey — how often?
canDo: I can say how often I do things.
I can use always, usually, often, sometimes and never in the right place.
I can ask: How often do you…?
teacherNotes: Zarfların yerini iki kuralla verin: 1) be fiilinden SONRA (I'm usually late), 2) diğer fiillerden ÖNCE (I always do my homework).
Ekrana 0%–100% bir çizgi çizip zarfları üzerine yerleştirin; öğrenciler kendi alışkanlıklarını çizgide göstersin.
Arap öğrenciler never ile not'u birlikte kullanabilir ("I don't never"); İngilizcede tek olumsuz yeterli.
Sınıf anketi: öğrenciler birbirine "How often do you…?" sorup sonuçları okuma metnindeki gibi raporlasın.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Our study habits
sections.intro: The results of the class survey, on the classroom wall.
paragraphs: Five students always do their homework — well done!
One student sometimes does it. We know who you are, Lucas!
Six students often listen to songs in English.
Three students never watch films in English. Try it — it's fun!
And everyone usually drinks coffee or tea in class.

items.prompt: How many students always do their homework?
How many students often listen to songs in English?

sections.title: Grammar: always, usually, often, sometimes, never
look: I **always** speak English with my roommates.
**How often** do you do your homework?
rules: Put them **before** the main verb: I **often** read.
Put them **after** am / is / are: I'm **always** happy.
Ask: **How often** do you …? — Every day. / Once a week. / Twice a week.
examples: I usually get up at eight.
We sometimes go to the café after class.
How often do you go to the library? — Once a week.

support.tr: Sıklık zarfları: always (her zaman), usually (genellikle), often (sık sık), sometimes (bazen), never (asla). Ana fiilden önce gelirler: I always do my homework. Ama am / is / are'dan sonra gelirler: I'm usually late. Türkçede yerleri esnektir, İngilizcede neredeyse sabittir.
support.ar: ظروف التكرار: always (دائمًا)، usually (عادةً)، often (غالبًا)، sometimes (أحيانًا)، never (أبدًا). تأتي قبل الفعل الرئيسي: I always do my homework، لكن بعد am / is / are: I'm usually late. ولا نستخدم not مع never، لأن never نفيٌ بذاتها.

tr.note: Zarf am / is / are'dan sonra, diğer fiillerden önce gelir.

ar.note: لا تجمع never مع not، وضع الظرف قبل الفعل الرئيسي.
wrong: I read always in the evening.
right: I always read in the evening.
